name: Campbell's - Stockton CA
type: Manufacturing - tomato processing (Campbell Soup Supply Co.)

fieldNotes.identity: Roster address (1330 W Fremont Street) is incorrect - it lands in a mixed urban area near the Stockton channel. The Campbell's Stockton facility is the Campbell Soup Supply Co. tomato-processing plant at 750/760 Industrial Drive, Stockton CA 95206 (Ortega area, south Stockton). OSM places 750 Industrial Drive at 37.9090,-121.2657; 2023 Street View shows a process tank bearing the red Campbell's logo. Locked center 37.9087,-121.2654.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance off Industrial Drive is a fenced driveway with a chain-link sliding gate (gate panels visible parked open in 2023 Street View). The whole frontage is fenced with privacy-slat chain-link. truckGate=true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the gate. guardShack=false; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard booth -> remote/kiosk/call-box check-in implied. remoteGs=true.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short approach from Industrial Drive into a parking lot/yard - holds only 1-2 trucks before the building.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved yard inside the gate provides some holding space before loading.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: This is a tomato-processing/paste plant dominated by process equipment (cooling towers, evaporators, tanks); modest dock-door loading. Estimated 4-8 -> 0-10 band; low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A few trailers parked in the yard (~8 visible); the long E-side rows are stacked bin/tote storage, not parked trailers. Small drop activity -> 0-10 band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot - only a handful of trailers in the working yard. dropYard=false.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main processing building plus a secondary structure; the large white warehouse to the SW is a separate property, not counted.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
